The conditioned reflex is not merely a simple stimulus-response but a complex associative learning process involving temporal integration of cues. The feedback loop embedded in this process implies recursive regulation, where each breath influences subsequent ones through internal feedback signals. The breakdown regime occurs when external stimuli exceed internal thresholds, leading to instability in respiratory rhythm—a key indicator of stress or learning fatigue.
